description: Source code implementing time utility functions, including date conversions, time synchronization, and skew calculations, derived from Howard Hinnant's algorithms.

methods.name: time_days_from_civil
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from a civil date to 1970-01-01, based on Howard Hinnant's date algorithms.

methods.name: timeutil_timegm64
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to a 64-bit Unix timestamp.

methods.name: timeutil_timegm
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to a time_t Unix timestamp, with range checking.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_state_update
methods.description: Updates the synchronization state with a new instant, adjusting base and latest references.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_state_set_skew
methods.description: Sets the skew factor in the synchronization state.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_estimate_skew
methods.description: Estimates the skew based on synchronization state data.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_ref_from_local
methods.description: Calculates reference timestamp from local timestamp considering skew.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_local_from_ref
methods.description: Calculates local timestamp from reference timestamp considering skew.

methods.name: timeutil_sync_skew_to_ppb
methods.description: Converts skew factor to parts-per-billion representation.
